mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h_conversations WHERE COALESCE(status, 'active') <> 'deleted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h_conversations WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m INNER JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h_messages hm INNER JOIN h_conversations hc ON hc.id = hm.conversation_id WHERE COALESCE(hc.status, 'active') <> 'deleted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_members tm INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tm.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE tm.deleted_at IS NULL AND tm.status = 'active'

SELECT htc.tool_name AS "toolName", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM h_tool_calls htc INNER JOIN h_messages hm ON hm.id = htc.message_id INNER JOIN h_conversations hc ON hc.id = hm.conversation_id GROUP BY htc.tool_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT htc.tool_name AS "toolName", COUNT(*) AS "errorCount" FROM h_tool_calls htc INNER JOIN h_messages hm ON hm.id = htc.message_id INNER JOIN h_conversations hc ON hc.id = hm.conversation_id WHERE htc.status = 'error' GROUP BY htc.tool_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_bases WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_temporary = false
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(type, ''), 'document') AS "kbType", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM knowledge_bases WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_temporary = false GROUP BY 1

SELECT k.file_type AS "fileType", COUNT(*) AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(k.file_size), 0) AS "storageSize" FROM knowledges k INNER JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.id = k.knowledge_base_id WHERE k.deleted_at IS NULL AND kb.deleted_at IS NULL AND kb.is_temporary = false GROUP BY k.file_type
SELECT agent_id AS "agentId", COUNT(*) AS "conversationCount" FROM h_conversations GROUP BY agent_id

SELECT hc.agent_id AS "agentId", COUNT(*) AS "totalFeedbacks", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hf.rating = 'like') AS "likeFeedbacks" FROM h_message_feedbacks hf INNER JOIN h_messages hm ON hm.id = hf.message_id INNER JOIN h_conversations hc ON hc.id = hm.conversation_id GROUP BY hc.agent_id

SELECT hc.agent_id AS "agentId", COUNT(*) AS "toolUsageCount" FROM h_tool_calls htc INNER JOIN h_messages hm ON hm.id = htc.message_id INNER JOIN h_conversations hc ON hc.id = hm.conversation_id GROUP BY hc.agent_id

#{slug}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custom_agents WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id AS "agentId", name FROM custom_agents WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.agent_id AS "agentId", COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id) AS "conversationCount", 'weknora' AS "system" FROM messages m INNER JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND m.agent_id <> '' GROUP BY m.agent_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id) DESC
